ambient_events: A mask comes off the rack and is checked at the lining before anything else.
The kettle goes on. Somebody is coming off a shift.
Hours are totted up on the tally board and somebody is owed a half day.
description: A blockhouse against the inside of the thorn beside the North Gate, with a stair up the outside to the walk and a shuttered slot facing the road. The mask rack is in here, and the tally board, and the kettle.
name: The Gate House
